settings.heading: About Us
settings.subheading: Get to know the people who know your gear best.

settings.heading: Our Name
settings.text:
Channel is more than a name—it’s our calling.

We connect people and institutions with reliable technology that helps them create, communicate, and worship with purpose.

From churches and schools to broadcasters and studios, we’re here not just to provide equipment, but to serve, support, and make a meaningful impact.

Technology is more than gear—it’s a bridge.

At Channel, we strive to be exactly that: a true Channel of Blessing.

settings.heading: Our Humble Beginnings
settings.text:
Channel International Enterprises took its first step in 2009 under its original name, Channel International Audio Supply, with its principal address at #380 Jacinto, Quezon Avenue, Quezon City.

After a year of operation, the company outgrew its initial 40-square-meter space and transferred to its current 250-square-meter facility located at 43 Don Alejandro Roces Avenue, Barangay Paligsahan, Quezon City—across Amoranto Sports Complex and in the same building as the Philippines’ largest recording studio, Asiatec Pinknoise now operated by Wild Grass Recording Studios.

Through the shared vision of four dedicated individuals, grew through perseverance, hard work, and a unified purpose. From those early days of toiling and groundwork, Channel steadily expanded its capabilities and reach.

Today, the company has grown significantly in both size and scope, becoming a complete source for audio and visual equipment needs. Channel International Enterprises also pioneered the Philippines’ first and only online store in its field, operating under its trade name channel.com.ph.

settings.feature_1_text:
Befittingly, the dictionary defines the word channel as a means of providing products or information available; a passage through which something flows; a route that enables movement and direction toward a specific destination.

True to this definition, we are steadfast in living up to our name. Channel International Enterprises exists to be exactly what it denotes—a conduit for technology and audio visual industries, making products readily available, easily accessible, and purposefully directed to where they are needed most.
settings.feature_2_text:
Channel supplies products and services to both online and offline customers, serving a diverse range of sectors that include houses of worships, universities, schools, hospitality, corporates, rental companies, broadcasting organizations, content creators and government agencies.

Our services extend beyond product supply and include consultation, system design, installation and configuration, control automation, testing, commissioning, training and documentation, system ongoing support and maintenance.
settings.feature_3_text:
We are committed not only to providing outstanding products and services, but—above all—to a simple yet profound calling: to be a CHANNEL of Blessing to every person and every place we are connected with.

This is a commitment we have set our hearts on, and it is the very reason we carry the name CHANNEL.

settings.heading: Our Services
settings.text:
• Retail Supply and Delivery — A comprehensive catalog of pro audio, video, broadcast, lighting, musical instruments, CCTV, power tools, and more.
  • Consultation & Needs Analysis — Understand your goals, room acoustics, lighting, users, and budget.
  • System Design & Engineering — Choose the right displays, speakers, microphones, cameras, control systems, and cabling.
  • Installation & Configuration — Mounting, wiring, calibration, network setup.
  • Control & Automation — Touch panels, tablets, or one-button controls.
  • Testing & Commissioning — Make sure everything works flawlessly together.
  • Training & Documentation — So your team can use it confidently.
  • Ongoing Support & Maintenance — Updates, troubleshooting, and upgrades.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.text: Have questions? We’ve answered some of the most common questions to help you find the information you need about our products, orders, payments, shipping, and services.

settings.question: 1. Why are some product prices not displayed on the website?
settings.answer: Prices may not be displayed due to fluctuating market rates, bulk pricing, or product customization options. You can submit a Price Inquiry to get accurate pricing.

settings.question: 2. Is Cash on Delivery (COD) available?
settings.answer: No. Cash on Delivery (COD) is currently not available. Please see our available payment methods and options here: View Payment Options

settings.question: 3. Can I order directly from the website?
settings.answer: Yes, you can order products directly through our website. However, we recommend contacting our sales team first to verify product availability and current status, as supplier prices and inventory may change without prior notice.

settings.question: 4. Can I request a quotation?
settings.answer:
Yes! You can request a formal quotation for your selected products through our website. This is recommended for bulk orders, project requirements, or customers who need an official quotation.

Learn more about our quotation process here: View Quotation Guide

settings.question: 5. Can I request a product that is not listed on the website?
settings.answer: Yes! If you cannot find a specific product or model, you may contact our sales team. We can check with our suppliers regarding availability, pricing, and special-order options.

settings.question: 6. Where is your store located?
settings.answer:
Our store is located at 43 Don A. Roces Ave., Brgy. Paligsahan, Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines 1103.

For directions and parking information, please visit our Directions & Parking Guide: View Directions & Parking
